text:
sam-eng: heads-up: deploybot blocked v4.0.1 for EU due to SBOM missing on registry + vuln scan flagged CVE-2026-1234 (medium). We have a 30m change window. thoughts?

deploybot: [automated] release v4.0.1 -> gates: SBOM_ATTACHMENT: MISSING (EU); VULN_SCAN: 1 MEDIUM (transitive). Action: BLOCK (region: eu-west-1). See pipeline: /pipelines/11011.

olivia-sec: Can someone confirm if the medium CVE affects runtime or only build/test tooling? Also need the cosign verify output and any evidence that SBOM exists but wasn't attached. Compliance will ask for an artifact-level SBOM for EU deployments.

jin-build: quick check: CVE is in `dev-utils` used only in build container. Not present in runtime layers. I ran: `cosign verify --output-json registry.redwood/v4.0.1` -> returned signature object but no `sbom` annotation on the manifest. We generated SBOM at build time but our publish step failed to push it to the OCI manifest annotations.

kevin-release: timeline: change window opens in 28m; if we wait for full fix we miss it and have to reschedule. Suggest split rollout: NA + APAC canary now, EU blocked until SBOM attached. Create a remediation ticket with SLA 24h to attach SBOM and re-evaluate EU.

maria-ops: We can do regional gating. I can set the deploy to `region_allowlist: [us-west-2, us-east-1, ap-southeast-1]` and tag EU as `deferred` in the release config. Also set monitor alert on org-telemetry for any auth regressions.

olivia-sec: Security OK with split rollout PROVIDED: 1) evidence bundle (cosign output, build logs, sbom checksum) is uploaded to CHG ticket, 2) a remediation ticket is created with assignee and 24h ETA, 3) automatic reblock on any anomalous security telemetry. I will sign the exception once CHG has the bundle.

sam-eng: I'll assemble the evidence bundle now. Commands I ran: ```bash
registry-cli fetch-manifest registry.redwood/v4.0.1 > manifest.json
cosign verify --output-json registry.redwood/v4.0.1 > cosign.json || true
jq -r '.annotations."io.redwood.sbom"' manifest.json > sbom-ref || true
sha256sum sbom.json > sbom.sha256
```

jin-build: created remediation PR to fix publish step: PR #4020 -> https://git.redwood/infra/publish/pull/4020. It will attach SBOM to manifest on publish.

kevin-release: CHG-4107 created: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-4107. Evidence uploaded to CHG-4107/evidence.tar.gz. Setting EU region blocked and kicking canary to allowed regions.

maria-ops: Applying region allowlist now and tagging release `v4.0.1-regional-split-sbom`. Deploybot will proceed in allowed regions.

deploybot: [automated] action: proceed rollout -> regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, ap-southeast-1 (canary 3%). region eu-west-1: BLOCKED (SBOM_ATTACHMENT: MISSING). Auto-unblock will require CHG attestation.

olivia-sec: Reviewing evidence now. If all good I'll post sign-off on CHG-4107. Remember to include remediation ETA and PR link.

sam-eng: evidence uploaded: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-4107/evidence.tar.gz. Release notes draft: "v4.0.1: EU deployment deferred due to missing SBOM attachment on OCI manifest; medium CVE in build-only `dev-utils`; remediation PR #4020 opened; will re-evaluate EU after SBOM attach (target 24h)."

jin-build: PR #4020 merged to main-build, publishing pipeline retriggered. I will post when SBOM is attached.

deploybot: [automated] note: re-evaluation scheduled for 24h. If SBOM not attached by then, EU will remain blocked until manual review.

olivia-sec: Verified evidence and added conditional sign-off on CHG-4107. :white_check_mark: Approved split rollout. Keep EU blocked until SBOM is present and rechecked.

kevin-release: Rolling now to allowed regions. Thanks team — will coordinate EU unblock when publish is fixed.
